summary.text: Marc Anderson is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 92, which he has represented since December 2024, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot against Democrat Krista Anderson.
His career experience includes work as a teacher.

paragraphs.text: Anderson graduated from Mechanicsburg High School, earned a bachelor's degree from York College of Pennsylvania, and received a graduate degree from Penn State University.
